_doc: Eval set for contracts/llm/ask_crm_route.json (fn:ask-crm, REQ-CRD-004). Each case: the question (Greek default, English supported), the template the router must pick, and the hints it must extract (null = not required). `seed_fact` is the value fn:ask-crm must return on the demo seed for that question (demo day 2026-11-16, caller nikos). `keyword: true` marks phrasings the code fallback router must also get right. Off-template questions must route to unknown, so the buddy says it doesn't know.
